title: Club Membership: mobile app access, prepay lengths, and signup promo credit by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for every Club Membership tier, whether mobile app booking and check-in is included, which lump-sum prepay lengths the tier allows, and any promotional one-time bill credit for signing up online.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Mobile app access included | Allowed prepay lengths | Signup promo credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | Yes | 3, 6, or 12 months | none |
| Student Metro Access | Yes | 3 or 6 months | $10.00 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | Yes | 3, 6, or 12 months | none |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | Yes | 3, 6, or 12 months | none |
| Premier All-Access | Yes | 3, 6, or 12 months | none |
| Black Card All-Access | Yes | 3, 6, or 12 months | none |
| Founding Legacy Access | Yes | 6 or 12 months | none |

## Reading the table
Mobile app access is included for every Club Membership tier. The allowed prepay lengths are the lump-sum lengths, in months, that the tier permits a member to prepay dues for. The signup promo credit is a one-time bill credit for signing up online, and only Student Metro Access carries a nonzero figure.
